about.title: About Us
about.description: We are a small cooperative company from South Brazil with an international team of professionals who have joined forces to create unique products for the web.

contact.title: Wanna Talk? Send us a message!
contact.description: Our team is excited to connect with you. Reach out to discuss your software needs today!

tldr.title: The tl;dr
tldr.description: We know you are a busy person, so we'll get straight to the point. We're a cooperative of designers and software developers who united to create high-quality products that might otherwise be impracticable. Our team is global, with our main office located in South Brazil.
tldr.trailing: If you wanna learn more, just keep scrolling

values.title: Get Real
values.description: We believe the best and mot authentic work happens when everyone is free to speak about anything at anytime.

values.title: Hold high standards
values.description: Every product we create has to be approved by our team. We wanna be know for our quality, and that's our main goal.

values.title: Be not afraid of the unknown
values.description: Everything changes, and it happens faster on this industry. We say yes to projects even if we are not sure how to do some parts of it.

values.title: Never drop a cliente
values.description: We create everything with long-term maintenance in mind. Once you become our client, we make a commitment to never let you down.
